propositions: Three independent identical lock acquisition loops (enrich_drain, compact_trigger, gc_trigger) must be consolidated into a shared stamped_lock module to eliminate duplication and inconsistency.

Release semantics differ across the three implementations: enrich_drain uses a single try block allowing close() errors to skip unlink(), while compact_trigger and gc_trigger use two independent try blocks ensuring unlink() always executes; the shared implementation must mandate the two-block form.
Stamp write format differs (drain appends newline, others do not) but is functionally invisible to readers due to .strip(); shared implementation must adopt the no-newline form.
Logging differs: drain names lock holder and warns on stamp failure; shared implementation must support optional describe_holder callback and emit stamp-failure WARNING for all three callers.

The monkeypatch anchors at test_lock_holder_labelling.py:134-135 target _acquire_trigger_lock and release_trigger_lock as module attributes with no raising=False, requiring both to remain as public module-level attributes in compact_trigger.
Guard criterion must identify exactly the three O_CREAT+stamped_file_is_stale pairs while excluding seven unrelated O_EXCL uses and the diagnostic reader doctor_locks.py.
